palette.notes: Frames (Octopath Traveler 0, filmed off a TV): saturated greens and warm wood in towns; blue-cyan cave light; battle scenes swing to full-screen orange-red and ice-blue spell colour. Saturation tuned with depth (wiki).

lighting: HD-2D: sprites in 3D sets with bloom and depth of field (sources.yaml). Frames show god-ray light shafts through forest, glowing bloom on spells that floods the screen, and a dark cave lit from one blue source above.
silhouette: Small sprites (about 1/10 of screen height) with clear job costumes (wiki); in battle the sprites stay small while spell effects are huge. Menu portraits show the same chibi sprite at tiny size.

motion.timing: No frame timings measured. Battle frames show big spell effects (fire wave, ice burst) changing every ~2 s in the clip; sprites themselves move little.

texture: Pixel sprites and pixel-textured props against 3D sets with blurred foliage; bloom softens edges of light. Diorama look: crisp middle plane, soft near and far.
camera: Slightly tilted 3D camera looking down at a flat sprite layer; depth of field blurs foreground leaves and far trees. Battle: side-on wide shot, enemies left, party right.
sound: Score by Yasunori Nishiki; each hero has a theme tied to their story.

acting.enters: Not shown; the overworld shots have the hero walking into a town path from below.
acting.acts: In battle, characters stay put and the spell effect does the acting: a wave of fire or ice crosses the whole screen.
acting.depth: Flat sprites in a 3D set; blur on near and far planes and light shafts between them, so a tiny sprite still reads in the sharp middle plane.

techniques: depth of field blur on near and far planes
small still sprite + screen-filling effect does the action
single coloured light source in dark scenes
costume = job, readable silhouette per hero
feel: crisp tiny sprite + blurred planes + bloom and light shafts = toy diorama that glows
for_fred: Fake HD-2D: blur a foreground layer and the far background, keep Fred crisp in the middle. For a big moment, keep Fred small and still and let one effect (a splash wave, a glow) cross the whole frame; blur and shrink him when he goes to the back.
